Backend pytest 12/12 pass. Frontend desktop + mobile verified: (a) Navbar wordmark sub-line = 'PRECISION PRODUCT CO. LTD.' (b) Hero subtext begins with 'Yue Fung Precision Product Co. Ltd.' and 'Excellent Standards' is wrapped in a font-medium gold span. (c) Company h2 = '40 Years Manufacturing Pedigree since 1984'; three value cards titled Heritage, Identity, Brand; Identity body contains the Tier-1 Stability/Evolution sentence; valuesNote contains '40 years of Heritage'. (d) Standards right column heading = 'Three Foundations of Trust' with '25+ Years of Consistency', 'Empowering Global Producers' and '“Zero Error” Backbone' cards; old reserved-areas paragraph is GONE; IATF 16949 disclaimer still present. (j) Service prefill still fills select-service='tooling'. (k) Mobile 390x844: 0 horizontal overflow; navbar 60px; mobile-menu-btn and settings-btn both visible. (l) 0 pageerrors and 0 console errors on landing page. Backend pytest suite: 12/12 pass.
critical_code_review_comments:
Automation note (not a bug): footer copyright line uses CSS text-transform:uppercase on the

, so Playwright inner_text() returns 'YUE FUNG METAL PLASTIC PRODUCTS CO. LTD.' not the original casing. Case-insensitive matching recommended for future tests. Content is correct and visually readable.
SettingsMenu still does not auto-close after selecting a locale/theme (carried over from iteration 3). Minor UX nit; not blocking.
